reply.text: {"route": "answer", "say": "For a hot marathon, salt matters more than people think, but there's no single right number, it depends on how salty your sweat runs and the conditions. General range coaches use is 500 to 1000mg sodium per hour during the race, more if you're a heavy salty sweater. In the days before, don't do anything exotic, just eat normally salted food and make sure you're drinking enough. If you want to dial it in precisely, that's worth a conversation with a sports dietitian who can look at your sweat rate."}
